items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Bechet worked with me a long time.

ctx.x: I see. Now, Bechet. Had you met Bechet before? Say, before you even worked with Kirby?
Yeah. I met Bechet... I was working someplace... I think in the spare time I had... I was talking a few minutes ago about I had about a few weeks off or something...
